title: Software
text:
MetricGraph
Random fields on metric graphs: Gaussian Whittle–Matérn fields, graph construction and inference for data on networks such as roads or rivers. CRAN · Documentation


ngme2
Linear latent non-Gaussian models with flexible distributions, for spatial, temporal and longitudinal data. CRAN · Documentation


SLOPE
Sorted L1 penalized estimation (SLOPE) for sparse regression. CRAN · Documentation · GitHub


Other code
Older research code, e.g. BayesFlow (Bayesian latent modelling of flow cytometry cell populations), is on GitHub.

    {State} {Space} {Model} {(Botten} {Ada)}},
  date = {2022-06-08},
  url = {https://www.iffs.se/},
  langid = {en},
  abstract = {In the Swedish election 2014 “Botten Ada”, a website using
    Bayesian modelling and probabilistic machine learning made
    predictions on the election outcome. In the upcoming Swedish
    election in the fall, “Botten Ada” and it’s founders, Måns
    Magnusson, Assistant Professor in statistics at Uppsala University
    and J++ a data journalism team based in Stockholm, will make a
    comeback with a new updated and refined model together with Jonas
    Wallin, Lund University. What degree of accuracy can be reached? And
    what place can prediction models such as these have in political
    science, and in academia at large?}
}

Jonas Wallin
text:
Associate Professor in Statistics at the Department of Statistics at Lund University, Sweden, where I am also director of doctoral studies.
My research is in computational and spatial statistics: Gaussian random fields and SPDE-based models, including Gaussian processes on metric graphs and non-Gaussian latent models; Bayesian computation; and sparse high-dimensional regression. Much of this work is developed together with open-source software. I also work on applications, in particular climate-sensitive infectious diseases.
Research interests

Gaussian random fields, SPDEs and Gaussian processes on metric graphs
Non-Gaussian latent variable models
Bayesian computation and MCMC
Sparse and high-dimensional regression (SLOPE)
Spatial confounding and forecast evaluation
Statistical modelling of climate-sensitive infectious diseases
